subject: CSS demo suggestion: a preview that scales inside its own frame
text:
Hi Zoran,

I have a small working example for your CSS resources: Take The Wall has a message designer with desktop and mobile preview frames inside a dialog. The preview uses container-type: inline-size and cqw typography, so switching the frame changes the composition without resizing the browser.

Try the designer: https://www.takethewall.com/?take=1
Inspect the CSS: https://github.com/sariserhan/takethewall/blob/main/app/globals.css (look for .preview-device and .preview-creative).

I make the project. The designer is free to try; activating a public takeover is a separate step. Would the live example be useful as a CSS Weekly resource?

Take The Wall
contact@takethewall.com
